name: 20232-sharegpt-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; the engine core and the model worker run as two processes (`distributed-executor-backend: mp`).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=512, bounded at 8192 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets and no tools; lengths are drawn from a clamped gaussian whose four parameters (scenario.json) are ShareGPT V3's token-length moments under this model's tokenizer.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant on an eight-billion-parameter model, serving 512 concurrent single-turn conversations from one GPU.
launch:
# Engine launch config. Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml (per-machine, not portable).
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# Engine core and model worker in separate processes; written out because it is not the
# default at world size 1, where vLLM puts the worker in the calling process.
distributed-executor-backend: mp

# Pinned because this engine build does NOT resolve them this way when built through
# AsyncLLMEngine.from_engine_args: unset, they fall through to 128 and 2048.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
